Nivel de vechime: Nivel mediu de experiență
Tip de angajare: Full-time
Sectoare de activitate: Tehnologie, informații și internet
Key Responsibilities
 Present your professional experience and expertise in iOS mobile development.
 Demonstrate your technical leadership and experience in mobile application development.
 Prepare a short slide presentation highlighting relevant projects, technical skills, and leadership experience.
 Present your experience in German during a 15-minute call in November.
 Answer questions about your professional background and technical expertise.
 Required Qualifications
 Strong professional experience in iOS mobile application development.
 Experience with Swift and the iOS ecosystem.
 Previous experience in a Lead Developer or senior mobile development role.
 Strong technical communication and presentation skills.
 Fluent German, with the ability to present technical experience confidently.
 Ability to prepare and deliver a concise presentation in German.
 Contract duration: 12 months, with the possibility of extension.B2 PFA/SRL/CIM
 Presentation: Approximately 15 minutes, supported by slides.
 Timing: November 2026.
 Availability: Immediate availability is not mandatory for the initial presentation. Candidates who are available to start the project will receive priority.
 Important Note
 At this stage, this is primarily a tender presentation opportunity. Participation in the initial call does not necessarily require immediate project availability. Further project details will be shared once they become available.
 Job Type: Full-time
 Application Question(s):
What is your desired net salary for this role?
Would you be available for a 15-minute call in November to present your experience in German?
 Language:
